text: I will cause them to be removed: Heb. I will give them for a moving
ask how thou doest?: Heb. to ask of thy thy peace
against the mother of the young me: Or, against the mother city, a young man spoiling, etc. Or, against the mother and the young men
I will cause the enmity to entreat thee well: Or, I will entreat the enemy for thee
I am call by thy Name: Heb. thy Name is called upon me
